status: Selected offline native questions completed within stated static coverage; owned sessions closed

canonical_export.interpretation: Zero structured unknown entries does not mean complete semantic recovery.

questions.question: How does PointersStore react to CoreData changes?
questions.finding: Cancels existing DispatchWorkItem, schedules replacement main-queue work after 400ms, then refreshes fetched/filtered pointer objects. This is code policy, not measured latency.

questions.question: What is the native pointer presentation data path?
questions.finding: Initializes published/filter state, builds NSFetchedResultsController against WalletStore persistence viewContext with predicate and two sort descriptors, performs fetch, applies search/favorites filtering and publishes results. Exact Swift sort keypaths remain unresolved.

questions.question: Does the selected points/total_value writer compute ranking?
questions.finding: Compares incoming structure float fields with DBPointerCard points/total_value and updates changed fields; also copies ordering/identity/relations. It is a materializer, not a recovered local ranking formula.

questions.question: What calls this materializer?
questions.finding: Two external calls from the selected parent routine create or find CoreData objects, copy input records to the materializer, add pointerCards relations and remove old pointerCards. Incoming references were filtered to external call sites; internal body references were not counted as callers. The parent record input producer and complete network decoder remain unproven.

questions.question: What uses stored total_value?
questions.finding: Formats stored total_value as estimated cents per dollar. Separate welcome-offer display arithmetic uses bonus quantity times point value divided by 100 for non-Cash currency; it is not proof of the card ranking calculation.

questions.question: What ranking policy does the vendor describe in the shipped artifact?
questions.finding: Packaged help describes category multiplier times configurable point value, with wallet ordering as a tie breaker. Not a verified algorithm or runtime outcome.

questions.question: Can this pass prove server ranking, bank synchronization, or all native offers behavior?
questions.finding: No. Server implementation, payload fixtures, complete upstream decoding, full offer automation paths, indirect Swift dispatch, live banking and executed ranking outcomes are outside demonstrated coverage. No further user intervention is pending in the offline scope.

method_limits: Decompiler output has inferred types, unknown locals and unreachable-block warnings. Exact preserved code is local-only.
Metadata reader has unresolved pointers, some family budgets and unsupported generic/resilient Swift tables.
No xref to the wallet URL literal does not prove absence of a wallet request; Swift register-built literals can lack direct references.
The selected merge caller establishes a reconciliation boundary, not a complete network-to-CoreData data-flow proof.
No user keychain data, bank data, receipts, account identifiers, tokens or live wallet rows were acquired by static analysis.
